guitar.evidence: Thomas Raggi frequently plays Gibson Les Pauls live, but not tied to one singularly iconic instrument.

tone.target: aggressive garage-rock crunch with wah-flecked fuzz edge
tone.profile: aggressive garage-rock crunch with wah-flecked fuzz edge
tone.summary: A high-gain, fuzzy rhythm tone built around a Marshall-style preamp (UK 45/50), enhanced by an early Fuzz or Distortion stage, and colored with Wah sweeps for that raw, aggressive sound.

rig.name: Måneskin - I WANNA BE YOUR SLAVE - Valeton GP-180
